At that time, the Venerable Śāriputra addressed the Buddha, saying:
“World-Honored One!
From where did this girl pass away to come and be born here?”
At that time, this woman manifested before Śāriputra another female body, no different from her own.
This woman then addressed the Venerable Śāriputra, saying:
"You asked why this woman passed away there and was reborn here."
Śāriputra said: "Sister!
This girl is an emanation; an emanation has neither birth nor death."
The woman said:
"Venerable Śāriputra! It is so!"

So it is! It is as you have said: for a Tathāgata, a Perfectly Awakened One, all dharmas are like the appearance of a magical transformation. If there were anyone who knew that all these dharmas are like the appearance of a magical transformation, they would have no birth-and-death.
At that time, the Buddha addressed Śāriputra:
"This bodhisattva mahāsattva is named Turned-from-Woman’s-Body; he has come here from the buddha-field of Akṣobhya for the sake of transforming sentient beings."

Śāriputra! This Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Turning of the Female Body has brought immeasurable and boundless sentient beings in this Sahā world to maturity, establishing them in the unsurpassed, right, and true path.
At that time, the Bodhisattva Turning the Female Body prostrated herself with her five limbs touching the ground in this physical form and spoke these words:
“World-Honored One!
If you do not grant me the prediction of unsurpassed enlightenment, nor the transformation of my female body into a male body, I shall not rise from before the Buddha’s feet.”
The five hundred women also prostrated themselves, casting their bodies to the ground, and made this vow:
"World-Honored One!
We now likewise shall not rise before the feet of the Buddha."
"You should also grant me the prediction of unsurpassed enlightenment.

At that time, the World-Honored One smiled. It is the nature of Buddhas, the World-Honored Ones, that when they smile, immeasurable rays of light of various wondrous colors—blue, yellow, red, white, purple, and crystal—issue forth from the Tathāgata’s mouth. Having issued forth, they universally illuminate immeasurable and boundless Buddha-worlds, reaching upward as far as the Brahma-world where they eclipse the sun and moon; they then circle the Buddha three times and enter the crown of the Tathāgata’s head.

At that time, the Venerable Ānanda, through the power of the Buddha, rose from his seat, bared his right shoulder, knelt with his right knee on the ground, joined his palms toward the Buddha, and addressed the Buddha, saying:
“World-Honored One!”
"The smiles of the Buddhas do not occur without cause or condition; for what reason do you smile now?
The Buddha said, "Ānanda!"
"Do you now see this Bodhisattva Who Turns the Female Body and the five hundred women prostrating themselves with their five limbs to the ground to pay homage at my feet?
"I have seen them,
World-Honored One!"
The Buddha said, “Ānanda!

This Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Turned-Woman-Body shall, after passing through incalculable kalpas, attain the unsurpassed, right, and true path, appearing in the world under the name Tathāgata King of Merit-Light. Having realized the Way of the Buddha, he will abide therein.”

These five hundred women became a host of bodhisattvas; they attained dhāraṇīs and unimpeded eloquence, and likewise acquired the eight kinds of necklaces and ornaments as taught by this Bodhisattva who has transformed her female body.
At that time, the Buddha King of Merit-Light (Guṇaprabhāsa-rāja) bestowed the prediction of unsurpassed enlightenment upon these five hundred bodhisattvas. Ānanda!

The buddha-field of the Buddha King of Merit-Light is abundant, peaceful, secure, and exceedingly delightful; because the multitudes of humans and devas are so numerous, the objects of enjoyment experienced by the sentient beings in that land are like those in the Tuṣita Heaven.
Ānanda! At that time, there will be no name for women in that buddha-field. Why is this?
All sentient beings are born by transformation within the Lotus Treasury, sitting cross-legged and practicing pure Brahma-conduct, adorning themselves with the aforementioned necklaces and ornaments.

At that time, the Bodhisattva Woman-Body-Turning and the five hundred women, having heard the Buddha’s prophecy, were filled with joy and exultation; they received and maintained this bliss, ascended into the air to a height of seven *tāla* trees, and immediately became men. Their appearance was like that of sixteen-year-old youths; descending from the sky, they joined their palms and gazed upon the Buddha.
At that time, the World-Honored One extended his golden right arm and stroked his crown; he immediately attained a samādhi named "Universal Illumination.
Then the Buddha addressed the Venerable Ānanda: "Ānanda!
"You should receive, uphold, read, recite, master, and extensively explain this sutra for others.
Ānanda addressed the Buddha,
saying, "World-Honored One!"
"I shall uphold this sutra.
World-Honored One,
what is the name of this sutra that I should uphold?"
The Buddha said, "Ānanda!

This sutra is titled 'The Chapter on the Skillful Means of Adornment with the Garland of Joy'; you should receive and uphold it. It is also titled 'The Dialogue Between the Bodhisattva Who Transforms the Female Body.'"

At that time, when the World-Honored One had finished preaching this Dharma, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Turning-the-Woman’s-Body, as well as the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattvas who had gathered from the ten directions, the Venerable Subhūti, the Venerable Śāriputra, the Venerable Ānanda, and the entire great assembly—including devas, nāgas, yakṣas, humans, and non-humans—having heard what the World-Honored One had said, rejoiced and received it with faith.

The *Sūtra on the Skillful Means of Adorning with the Joyful Necklace Spoken by the Bodhisattva Turning the Female Body* is hereby complete. From the words "turning the female body" to "is hereby complete," there are seventeen characters that do not appear in my own manuscript.
